newsitem.title: USA: A.T. Cross sees Q2 loss $0.32/shr, charge.
newsitem.headline: A.T. Cross sees Q2 loss $0.32/shr, charge.

text.p: A.T. Cross Co said Thursday it expects a loss in its second quarter of $0.32 per share, including a restructuring charge and a loss to discontinue operations of its Manetti-Farrow subsidiary.

The company said the Manetti-Farrow subsidiary will discontinue distribution of Fendi accessory products by the end of 1997, and subsequently cease operations. The $2.4 million net loss from discontinued operations relates solely to Manetti-Farrow.
The company said the restructuring charge recognizes a loss on the pending sale of its 130,000 square foot distribution center in Lincoln, R.I.
The company will report second quarter operting results July 18.
The company's quarter ended June 30. It also said it expect a net loss of $5.3 million.

The company said it expects net sales from continuing operations to be down about 20 percent compared to the same period a year ago. It reported net sales of $39.0 million and net income of $794,000, or $0.05 a share, in the second quarter of 1996.
